firm_data.firm_description: Goldberg, Miller & Rubin is a Philadelphia-based civil defense attorney with offices in Pennsylvania, New York and New Jersey. The firm handles motor vehicle and truck liability, hospital defense, general liability, healthcare and insurance fraud, plaintiff/personal injury, toxic tort and asbestos litigation, and workers’ compensation cases.
notable_facts: The firm has built a solid foundation in civil litigation with several hundred defense verdicts and hundreds more defense arbitration awards.
GMR has extensive expertise defending auto liability, premise liability, toxic tort, products liability, bad faith/coverage and healthcare fraud cases.

The Firm is recognized for successfully prosecuting complex civil RICO claims with multi-million dollar verdicts and managing a large, multinational company’s asbestos litigation for more than three decades.
